title: RHealthTwin: Towards Responsible and Multimodal Digital Twins for Personalized Well-being
reasoning: The core contribution of the paper is the 'Responsible Health Twin' framework, which explicitly operationalizes the World Health Organization's (WHO) six guiding ethical principles for healthcare AI. The paper develops a specific 'WHO-aligned Responsibility Rubric (WRR)' to benchmark and evaluate the ethical compliance of the model, making ethics a central component of the system's design and evaluation rather than just a secondary discussion.
